Yarmolyntsi Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Khmelnytskyi Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Yarmolyntsi's Jews, present from the second half of the 18th century, saw their numbers reduced fourfold after a 1775 Haidamak raid, before rebuilding to a peak of 2,633 by 1897. On July 5, 1920, during the Soviet-Polish War, Professor Israel Friedlaender and Rabbi Bernard Cantor — delegates of the Jewish Joint Distribution Committee, engaged in humanitarian relief work — were murdered in the town. A ghetto established September 2, 1942 absorbed Jews from neighboring towns; according to some sources, 14,000 Jews were killed in Yarmolyntsi during the occupation. This is the older of the town's two Jewish cemeteries.
